scope: Wide-version compatibility and real-host acceptance for 0.2.2. Documentation and images were finalized after runtime validation; every runtime entry and runtime manifest field matches the tested tarball byte-for-byte.

compatibility.dshPeersRationale: The runtime gate is the Host's own evaluatePluginCompatibility, which evaluates only @deepseek-ai/dsh and @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peers. No plugin-side allowlist, no version exemption, no shim package.
compatibility.rangeRationale: A bare caret range does not admit a prerelease, so the ranges name both tested lines explicitly. Versions inside the range but never executed are explicitly not claimed as tested.

missingInterfaceBehaviour.missingMember: A service that exists but lacks a member makes the plugin report the exact missing member during initialization; the service stays unavailable.
